notablePrerequisites: Battered Golem and Amoeboid Changeling do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's first ability by tapping it, causing Battered Golem to gain all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Battered Golem by paying {R} and tapping it.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
When the Treasure enters the battlefield, Battered Golem triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Battered Golem ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 2.
